g.title: crate Runs scripted input and virtual time with optional mirror windows.
crate::backend Start and advance the virtual backend and expose owned observations.
crate::clock Monotonic virtual clock shared by script and backend.
crate::mirror Adapt native mirror output without introducing native input.
crate::raw Expose raw platform input accepted by the virtual script.
crate::script Queue ordered platform input and environment or service prerequisites.
crate::surface Track virtual presentation surface generations.
crate::window In-memory shell services with an optional native display mirror.
